backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no methods.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking deployment-related files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: List of prewritten summaries for key frontend files including components, hooks, config, and deployment docs.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide describing prerequisites and production build steps for the frontend.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining light/dark color variables and global layout rules.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the frontend root and main TypeScript module.
frontend/scripts/validate-icp0-subdomain: Node script validating icp0.io subdomains and printing deployment next‑steps.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React Valentine page with Yes/No interaction and evasive No button behavior.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook creating and refreshing backend actors based on Internet Identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useEvasiveButton.ts: Hook generating random safe positions and handling pointer/touch events for an evasive button.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Authentication context and provider managing Internet Identity login, state, and persistence.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers, global CSS variables for light/dark themes, base styles, and simple fade/zoom animations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and an InternetIdentityProvider before rendering App.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom color tokens, typography and animation plugins, and extended theme settings.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, deployment notes, and feature-tracking information for the Romanticproposal project.
